text:
Maya R.: Quick PSA — Brightline marked 5 accounts as "SI-owned (signed intake)" in the marketplace form and ownership flipped in SF. Need a short reconciliation and updated ROE so field doesn't get surprised.

Owen P.: Which accounts? any active demos or POCs?

Maya R.: acct_6007 (demo 4/22), acct_6015 (POC), acct_6033 (early). Jia: you have the intake submission id?

Jia (Brightline): Yep, intake #BL-2026. We set "signed_with_customer": true and marked them as SI_lead per our charter in manufacturing. We didn't realize the system would auto-change the SF owner immediately. Sorry for the noise.

Owen P.: Ok — operational fix: add a 24h pending flag on any intake that includes signed_with_customer + si_owner_change. That gives partnerships a chance to confirm "customer-approved SI ownership".

Maya R.: Also add a co_sell_role field (Redwood_lead, SI_lead, Joint) so downstream routing respects play.

Jia (Brightline): We can stop outreach until you confirm. For the demo on acct_6007, Brightline can be joint or fly-in — whatever Redwood prefers.

crm-bot: Automated note added to acct_6007 and acct_6015: "SI ownership change detected via marketplace intake BL-2026 — pending partnerships review (24h hold)."

Owen P.: I'll stage this CRM rule in staging today. Patch YAML is tiny:
trigger: marketplace_intake_si_owner_change
actions:
  - tag: pending_partnerships_review
  - notify: [partnerships, owner]
  - create_task: confirm_si_ownership
  - revert_if_no_confirm: 24h

Maya R.: Thanks. Jia please update the intake record with a note that Brightline will not send customer invites until partnerships confirms. Jia: can you do that now?

Jia (Brightline): Done. Added note and set co_sell_role=Joint for acct_6007.

Maya R.: Perfect. We'll share a 1-pager with SIs tonight clarifying intake expectations: signed checkbox does not equal instant SF owner change; partnerships must confirm within 24h. Closing after CRM rule is live.

Owen P.: Rolling the rule to prod after Leah's one-pager is published.

Maya R.: Closing thread. Thanks all. :pray:
